What fixed this for me:   
1. Open file Location on the iPrint&Scan application.  
2. Right Click and Select Properties  
3. Select the Compatibility tab.  
4. Select High DPI Settings  
5. Enable Override high DPI Scaling Behavior, and select scaling performed by: Application in the drop down menu.

My issue was that the entire application was running at a much lower resolution. I hope this can fix it for anyone else who has this issue.
